| [__init__.py](__init__.py.md) | current | Re-exports the synthesis layer framework and the G1–G10 layers. |

| [intake.py](intake.py.md) | current | G1 Intake (reject an unimplementable spec before any model call) and G2 Identity (reuse a version built from this exact spec). |
| [planning.py](planning.py.md) | current | G3 Test planning: decides what the code will be held to before it exists, including up to 3 realistic inputs written by the model. |
